newsitem.title: INDIA: New Holland says to invest $50 mln in India.
newsitem.headline: New Holland says to invest $50 mln in India.

text.p: Agricultural equipment-maker New Holland said on Wednesday it plans to make an initial investment of $50 million in a tractor manufacturing plant in India.
The agricultural and construction equipment maker said in a statement that the plant in Greater Noida, near the Indian capital, would make Ford-branded tractors in the 35-75 horsepower range.
"The plant at Greater Noida would be on the lines of latest technology, with the first phase capable of manufacturing 18,000 tractors per annum," the statement said.
New Holland is controlled by Dutch-registered New Holland NV, a subsidiary of Fiat Spa, and began trading on Wall Street in November last year after a public share offering.
